What is:
–Science?–the state of knowing:knowledge as distinguished fromignoranceor misunderstanding–Merriam Webster -https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/science
–Biology?–The scientific study of life…………. OR
–The state of knowing or understanding LIFE
–All forms of life share common properties
explanation: This slide defines the terms 'Science' and 'Biology'. According to the Merriam-Webster dictionary, science is defined as 'the state of knowing: knowledge as distinguished from ignorance or misunderstanding.' Biology is defined as 'the scientific study of life' or 'the state of knowing or understanding life.' Crucially, the slide notes that all forms of life, despite their immense diversity, share common properties.
